sf.wahl.h: How would you like to answer the questions?
sf.wahl.hint: You can switch at any time. Your answers are kept.
sf.zuSchritt: Step by step – one question per page
sf.warum: Why does the app ask this?
sf.ueb.t: Check your answers. Use “change” to correct an answer.
sf.warn.zahl: Please enter a number, for example 450.
sf.warn.geb: Please enter a year with 4 digits, for example 1962.
sf.warn.plz: Please enter a postcode with 5 digits.
sf.q.adults: Do you live alone or with a partner?
sf.h.adults: This means marriage, a registered partnership or a steady partnership in the same home. The app asks about children next.
sf.q.kids: How many children under 18 live with you?
sf.q.kidsU6: How many of them are younger than 6?
sf.q.kids14: How many of them are 14 to 17 years old?
sf.h.kids14: The children's age changes the need, for example for the Kinderzuschlag (child supplement).
sf.q.uvgWechsel: Is a child often with the other parent, 40 % of the time or more?
sf.h.uvgWechsel: About 6 out of 14 days, for example every other week. Important for the Unterhaltsvorschuss (maintenance advance).
sf.q.uvgPartner: Who is the second adult in the household?
sf.q.young: How many children aged 18 to 24 in school, training or university live with you?
sf.q.geb: In which year was the oldest adult in the household born?
sf.h.geb: This shows whether retirement age has been reached.
sf.q.schwanger: Is anyone in the household pregnant (from the 13th week)?
sf.q.baby: Is there a baby or is one coming soon?
sf.q.egVor: How much net income per month did the person who gets Elterngeld (parental allowance) have before the birth?
sf.h.egVor: Average of the 12 months before the birth. Enter 0 if there was no income.
sf.h.aufenthalt: There are separate benefits for people in the asylum procedure, with a Duldung (toleration) or obliged to leave. Special rules apply to people from other EU countries.
sf.q.euArbeit: Do you work in Germany or have you worked here?
sf.h.euArbeit: A Minijob or self-employed work also counts.
sf.q.euJahre: Since when have you lived in Germany?
sf.q.pflege: Does anyone in the household have a Pflegegrad (care level)?
sf.q.bhPerson: Does anyone in the household have a disability?
sf.h.bhPerson: Child aged 18 or over: only if the disability already existed before the 25th birthday (important for Kindergeld). Otherwise choose “an adult”.
sf.q.gdb: Which degree of disability (GdB) has been determined?
sf.h.gdb: It is in the decision from the Versorgungsamt or in the Schwerbehindertenausweis (severe disability card).
sf.q.blind: Can the person see very poorly or not at all?
sf.q.bhMehr: Does any of this apply to the person with a disability?
sf.q.bhWeitere: Do other people with a severe disability live in the household?
sf.h.bhWeitere: Only people with GdB 100, or GdB 50 or more and a Pflegegrad. Important for Wohngeld (housing benefit) and the Wohnberechtigungsschein.
sf.q.emStd: Can an adult only work to a limited extent because of illness or disability?
sf.q.em5: Has this person paid into the pension insurance for at least 5 years?
sf.h.em5: 3 of those years in the last 5 years. Important for the Erwerbsminderungsrente (reduced earning capacity pension).
sf.q.ernaehrung: Does anyone need an expensive diet because of an illness?
sf.h.ernaehrung: For example with coeliac disease, cystic fibrosis or severe kidney disease. There may be an additional allowance (Mehrbedarf).
sf.q.arbeitSit: Is an adult unemployed, soon unemployed or on sick leave?
sf.q.algZeit: In the last 30 months, did they work for at least 12 months with compulsory insurance?
sf.h.algZeit: Periods with Krankengeld (sick pay) count. Important for Arbeitslosengeld (unemployment benefit).
sf.q.algMonate: How long in total did they work with compulsory insurance in the last 5 years?
sf.q.krankWochen: How long have they been on sick leave?
sf.q.lohnVorher: What was the last gross monthly pay from work?
sf.h.lohnVorher: For the rough amount of Arbeitslosengeld or Krankengeld. It is on the last payslip.
sf.q.ausbildung: Is anyone in the household in training or studying?
sf.q.babMehr: Does any of this apply to you?
sf.h.babMehr: Important for the Berufsausbildungsbeihilfe (vocational training allowance).
sf.q.wohnart: Do you rent or own your home?
sf.q.miete: How much is your total rent per month (including heating)?
sf.h.miete: Basic rent, service charges and heating together. In a shared flat only your own share.
sf.q.miete.eigen: How much are your housing costs per month?
sf.h.miete.eigen: Loan payments (interest and repayment), service charges, property tax and heating together.
sf.q.heiz: How much of that is heating per month?
sf.h.heiz: It is in the rental contract or the service charge statement. This makes the Wohngeld calculation more precise. Without it, the app estimates carefully.
sf.q.warmwasser: Does hot water come from a boiler or instantaneous water heater in the flat?
sf.q.hhAndere: Do other adults live with you who have not been counted yet?
sf.h.hhAndere: Relatives are, for example, parents, adult children or siblings.
sf.q.plz: What is the postcode of where you live?
sf.h.plz: The app uses it to find your federal state and Mietenstufe (rent level). It stays on your device.
sf.q.plzPick: Which town do you live in?
sf.q.bundesland: Which federal state do you live in?
sf.h.bundesland: Important for Blindengeld (blind allowance) and the Wohnberechtigungsschein.
sf.q.mietstufe: Which Mietenstufe (rent level) does your town have?
sf.h.mietstufe: The Mietenstufe is important for Wohngeld. Without it, the app calculates carefully.
sf.q.ekArt: What is the income per month?
sf.h.ekArt: Are there two incomes? Choose the larger one here. The app asks about the second one afterwards. Do not enter Kindergeld, Wohngeld or Kinderzuschlag here.
sf.q.brutto.lohn: How much is the gross pay per month (before deductions)?
sf.q.brutto.rente: How much is the gross pension per month (before deductions)?
sf.q.brutto.selbst: How much is the profit per month before tax?
sf.h.brutto: It is on the payslip or pension notice. If it is missing, the app estimates it from the net amount.
sf.q.netto: How much of it arrives in the bank account each month?
sf.h.netto: If it is missing, the app estimates the net amount.
sf.q.netto.selbst: What is left per month after tax and insurance?
sf.q.betrag: How much is the monthly amount according to the decision (Bescheid)?
sf.q.betrag.wfbm: How much workshop pay is paid out per month?
sf.q.betrag.unt: How much maintenance for the person themself arrives per month?
sf.h.ekZweit: For example pay and maintenance, pension and Minijob, or workshop pay and pension.
sf.q.ekZweitBetrag: How much of the second income arrives per month?
sf.q.zusatzRente: How much of it is a company pension, Riester pension or private pension (net per month)?
sf.h.zusatzRente: For Grundsicherung im Alter (basic income support in old age), part of such pensions is not counted.
sf.q.grundrente33: Are there at least 33 years of pension contributions?
sf.h.grundrente33: From work (also in a workshop), raising children or caring. Important for the Grundrente allowance.
sf.q.wfbmEssen: Is lunch provided at the workshop?
sf.q.unterhalt: How much maintenance does the other parent pay per month for the children?
sf.h.unterhalt: Together for all children. Do not enter Unterhaltsvorschuss here.
sf.q.waisen: How much orphan's pension do the children get per month?
sf.h.waisen: Only if a parent has died. Together for all children.
sf.q.kindEink: How much income of their own do the children have per month?
sf.h.kindEink: For example training pay or a Minijob, together. Without Kindergeld, maintenance and orphan's pension.
sf.q.uzBetrag: How much maintenance do you pay per month to people outside the household?
sf.h.uzBetrag: For children who do not live with you, or for former partners. As much as you really transfer.
sf.q.uzTitel: Is the amount fixed, for example by a court decision, a Jugendamt certificate or a notarial contract?
sf.q.vermoegen: How much savings does the household have in total?
sf.h.vermoegen: Accounts, savings books, securities. Do not count: the home you live in and the car.
sf.q.autoWert: Roughly how much is your car worth?
sf.q.autoBraucht: Is the car needed because of a disability or for getting to work?
sf.h.bezug: The app then shows these benefits as “already received” and checks what else is possible.
